notes:
## DaoXE multi-model fallback (one API key)

**What it does:** calls a primary model on DaoXE; if that request errors, it automatically retries the same prompt on a fallback model - all through **one** OpenAI-compatible key and **one** Base URL (`https://daoxe.com/v1`).

### Setup (2 minutes)
1. **Credentials → New → Header Auth** - Name: `Authorization`, Value: `Bearer <YOUR_DAOXE_API_KEY>`. Select it in both HTTP nodes.
2. Open **Set inputs** and replace `YOUR_DAOXE_MODEL_ID` / `YOUR_DAOXE_FALLBACK_MODEL_ID` with two exact model IDs available to your account (from your DaoXE dashboard or `GET /v1/models` - do not hardcode a list from a blog post).
3. Click **Test workflow**.

DaoXE is a multi-model, multi-protocol gateway. Not available in mainland China.
https://daoxe.com
